partner: Kingsmere University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
what_we_depend_on_them_for: Supplies historical data and access to staff for testing
current_status: Data-sharing agreement signed March 2026 for 'discovery and product research' only; expires 31 March 2027; does not cover live operational use
risk_or_issue: No pilot contract. Sponsor is the Deputy COO, not a budget holder. Trust CIO has not committed integration capacity.

partner: Corelia Systems (EPR supplier at Kingsmere and 4 of our 8 Live customers)
what_we_depend_on_them_for: Real-time admission, discharge and transfer feed
current_status: No partnership agreement. Interface requests go through each trust's change queue.
commercial_terms: Third-party API licence quoted at GBP 18,000 per trust per year; 4-6 month lead time for a new interface
risk_or_issue: Vendor could build a competing feature. Without a live feed, Horizon runs on a nightly file (data up to 30 hours old).

partner: Hyperscale cloud provider (UK South and EU West regions)
current_status: Start-up credits of GBP 9,000 per month until 28 February 2027
risk_or_issue: Hosting cost rises when credits end. No region in Kenya or Indonesia approved under our current security accreditation.

partner: Contract Clinical Safety Officer (individual, 2 days per week)
what_we_depend_on_them_for: Owns the clinical risk management file (DCB0129) and signs the safety case
risk_or_issue: Single person. Has told us Horizon needs its own hazard log and safety case: about 30 days of work not yet scheduled.

partner: Aire Valley University - Health Economics Unit
commercial_terms: GBP 62,000 for a 9-month before-and-after evaluation; GBP 140,000 for a stepped-wedge design across wards
risk_or_issue: Without independent evidence, trust CFOs discount our savings claims. Evaluation results would arrive after the next funding round.

partner: Public-sector procurement frameworks (G-Cloud and regional frameworks)
what_we_depend_on_them_for: Lets NHS buyers award without a full tender
current_status: Listed for Wardline Live. Horizon not yet listed.
risk_or_issue: Next framework refresh window closes 30 January 2027.

partner: Penetration testing and security assurance firm
what_we_depend_on_them_for: Annual test and evidence for the NHS digital technology assessment
risk_or_issue: Horizon needs to be in scope before any live use.

what_we_depend_on_them_for: Would fund and help run a Kenya pilot
commercial_terms: USD 150,000 over 2 years; tool free to counties for 3 years; Foundation receives hospital data for its own research; Foundation's logo first
risk_or_issue: Revenue is grant-only. Data-sharing terms may conflict with our own privacy commitments. The Foundation's previous pilots in the county mostly ended when grants did.

partner: County Government of Kisima - Department of Health
what_we_depend_on_them_for: Access to Kisima County Referral Hospital
current_status: Draft memorandum of understanding; not signed
risk_or_issue: County leadership changes with elections (next general election August 2027). Health worker strikes stop data collection.

partner: PT Nusa Medika Digital (hospital information system vendor)
what_we_depend_on_them_for: Route to public hospitals; data access through its SIMRS
commercial_terms: Vendor keeps 40% of revenue; 5-year exclusivity for Indonesia; model hosted on vendor's servers in Jakarta; vendor brands it as its own module
risk_or_issue: Loss of control over the model and customer relationship. Exclusivity blocks the private hospital group opportunity unless carved out.

risk_or_issue: Clinical terms do not map one-to-one (for example 'bed occupancy rate' vs 'beds needed').

partner: Kingsmere's social care and community partners (local authority, community trust)
what_we_depend_on_them_for: Community bed and care-package capacity data
risk_or_issue: Discharge delays drive a large share of bed occupancy; we have no data on the capacity that causes them.
